snapshot.note: Snapshot lane owns fresh-pod qualification; CUDA Graph flag is not a process snapshot.

whole_evaluation_allocation.method: Offline evidence-only whole scheduled-pod GPU reservation accounting; no GPU execution or cluster access.
whole_evaluation_allocation.clock_assumption: Recorded cluster/client UTC clocks are comparable. Bounds do not cover unmeasured clock skew. Killing is treated as stopping initiation, not release completion.
whole_evaluation_allocation.timestamp_resolution_policy: Primary bounds subtract one second per pod from the recorded lower duration; successor-schedule upper bounds add one second. Successful wait=true completion is already a later client-clock upper endpoint. Raw recorded-time bounds are also retained.
whole_evaluation_allocation.denominator: Artifact-valid inference requests, not samples, generated structures, clinically useful results, CPU prepare calls or only warm successes. Includes exploratory/private-seed candidates and batch requests.
whole_evaluation_allocation.scope: Six Protenix benchmark/prototype pod UIDs only; snapshot experiments and model image-build GPU resources are not included. Parallel reservations on the two distinct nodes are added as GPU-seconds, not merged into wall time.

economics.allocation_note: Request-window cost excludes occupied time outside requests; whole-evaluation bounds include initialization, operator gaps, failures and cleanup. Neither is a saturation-price forecast or scientifically acceptable-result cost.
